Pre-sweep against origin/main `0886e96f03a` — description amended before spending a gate slot.

**Two AC defects found and fixed; no scope change.**

1. **AC1 could pass with half the work undone.** It grepped case-sensitively for `deprecated alias`. `docs/ticket-model.md:300` matches, but `src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py:189` reads "a **DEPRECATED** alias" in caps and therefore never matched. The criterion was already satisfied on that file before any edit. AC1 is now `grep -in`, and gains a second clause asserting the stale "intercepted in edit_core" claim is gone — that sentence is the substantive error in the comment, and no spelling of the first grep detects it.

2. **AC2's exempt fixture does not exist.** The plan said to leave `:472` alone as a fixture name. There is no `[operator-attested]` at `:472`. The file holds exactly 4 occurrences — `:112`, `:121`, `:1160`, `:1185` — and the Approach rewrites all 4, so `grep -c` = 0 is reachable. `[non-codebase]` is 1 today (`:317`), so the post-state is exactly 5. AC2 now states both numbers rather than `>= 5`.

**Every citation had drifted.** Re-measured and corrected in the description's new table: `ticket-model.md` 288→300, `composer_edit.py` 200-203→187-190, `plan-review-gate.md` 113/122-123/1158/1183→112/121/1160/1185, `migrations.md` 99/256/260/264/293→119/276/280/284/313. Two citations named the wrong file: the removal is enforced at `composer_edit.py:282` (not `:301-302`) with the CLI refusal at `:392-394`/`:401` (not `:422-426`), and the MCP tag params live in `_mcp_tool_specs.py:63-65` (not `_mcp_writes.py:361-380`, which contains no such symbols).

**The premise checks out.** `src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py:151-159` already documents the correct contract — the `tags=` set-alias "was removed pre-1.0 — DE7; it is now rejected as an unknown field" — and pops only `add_tags`/`remove_tags`/`set_tags`, so `tags` reaches `edit_core`'s unknown-field rejection. `edit_core` (`:262-270`) takes `tag_add`/`tag_remove`/`tag_set` and performs no `tags` interception, which is why `composer_edit.py:190`'s claim is stale. This story aligns two prose sites with a source of truth that is already right; it changes no behaviour.

Also added: the Testing section now records that none of the pinned modules carries an `integration`/`external` marker, so `make verify` genuinely executes them.

## Context / Problem
`docs/ticket-model.md:300-301` and the comment `src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py:187-190` still describe the library/MCP `edit_ticket(tags=…)` set-alias as live. It was removed: the authoritative docstring `src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py:151-159` states "the ``tags=`` set-alias was removed pre-1.0 — DE7; it is now rejected as an unknown field", and the code pops only `add_tags`/`remove_tags`/`set_tags`, so `tags` falls through to `edit_core`'s unknown-field rejection (`composer_edit.py:282`; CLI refusal `:392-394`, `:401`). The MCP surface exposes only the three delta params (`src/rebar/_mcp_tool_specs.py:63-65`, documented `:344-347`). `composer_edit.py:190`'s claim that the alias is "intercepted in edit_core" is stale — `edit_core` (`:262-270`) takes `tag_add`/`tag_remove`/`tag_set` and has no `tags` interception. This story brings the two stale prose sites into line with a source of truth that is already correct.

`docs/plan-review-gate.md:112,121,1160,1185` teach `[operator-attested]`; ADR 0101 makes `[non-codebase]` canonical and keeps the old spelling as an accepted, UNDOCUMENTED alias (`tests/unit/test_guides.py` enforces this for the packaged guide). `docs/migrations.md:119` cites `init.py` for the ensure units, which live in `src/rebar/_commands/_init_ensures.py` (reachable as `init._<name>`, pinned by `src/rebar/_store/ensures.py:93-100`, which maps each unit name to `init._<name>_unit`, and documented at that module's `:14`; exercised by `tests/unit/test_ensures_late_binding.py`); `:276,:284` cite bare `compact.py` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`) and `:280,:313` bare `_processors.py` (`src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py`).

## Cites re-measured on origin/main `0886e96f03a`
Every line number below was re-measured against the tree, not carried forward. The original plan's citations had drifted by 1–20 lines and named two files that do not hold the cited text:

| Plan said | Actual |
|---|---|
| `ticket-model.md:288-289` | `:300-301` |
| `composer_edit.py:200-203` | `:187-190` |
| `composer_edit.py:301-302` (removal) | `edit_core` unknown-field reject `:282` |
| CLI refusal `:422-426` | `:392-394`, `:401` |
| `_mcp_writes.py:361-380` | `_mcp_tool_specs.py:63-65`, `:344-347` |
| `plan-review-gate.md:113` | `:112` |
| `:122-123` | `:121` |
| `:1158` | `:1160` |
| `:1183` | `:1185` |
| `:472` fixture ("leave it") | no `[operator-attested]` at `:472`; only 4 exist repo-wide in that file, all rewritten here |
| existing `[non-codebase]` at `:318` | `:317` |
| `migrations.md:99` | `:119` |
| `:256`, `:264` (`compact.py`) | `:276`, `:284` |
| `:260`, `:293` (`_processors.py`) | `:280`, `:313` |

The original plan also quoted the `composer_edit.py` comment as beginning `# Tags are NOT an EDIT field (P2.3)`; the tree reads `# Tags are NOT an EDIT field any more (P2.3)`.

## Approach
- `docs/ticket-model.md:300-301` → "The library/MCP `edit_ticket(tags=…)` set-alias was removed pre-1.0; `tags` is rejected as an unknown edit field — use `add_tags` / `remove_tags` / `set_tags`."
- `composer_edit.py:187-190` → keep the first two lines, then: `# concurrent tag add. The library/MCP edit_ticket(tags=...) set-alias was removed` / `# pre-1.0 (DE7); "tags" is now an unknown field, refused below.` This deletes the stale "intercepted in edit_core" claim.
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md`: `:112` "NOT tagged `[operator-attested]`" → "NOT tagged `[non-codebase]` (ADR 0101)"; `:121` "The `[operator-attested]` tag matcher is single-sourced in `det_operator_attested` (`_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`…" → "The `[non-codebase]` tag matcher (which also accepts the legacy spelling) is single-sourced in `det_operator_attested` (`_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`…" (symbol names are real, keep them); `:1160` "…the `[operator-attested]` tag (ADR-0043)" → "…the `[non-codebase]` tag (ADR-0043, renamed by ADR 0101)"; `:1185` "an `[operator-attested]` AC item" → "a `[non-codebase]` AC item".
- `docs/migrations.md:119` → "(`_commands/init.py` is the entry point; the units themselves live in `_commands/_init_ensures.py` and stay reachable as `init._<name>`)"; `:276,:284` `compact.py` → `_commands/compact.py`; `:280,:313` `_processors.py` → `reducer/_processors.py`.

## Scope
`docs/ticket-model.md`, `src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py` (comment only), `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/migrations.md`. Not: `docs/config.md` (config epic), `docs/adr/0086…` (overlap epic), `docs/adr/0059…` (historical).

## Testing
`make lint`; `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`; `pytest tests/unit/test_gen_ticket_model_taxonomy.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_unlink_documentation_contract_b6e1.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_docs.py tests/unit/test_plan_review.py tests/unit/test_s4_prompt_cutover_edge.py tests/unit/test_project_portability_docs.py tests/unit/test_det_floor_clarity.py tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_removal.py tests/unit/test_guides.py tests/unit/test_ensures_late_binding.py`. These modules carry no `integration`/`external` marker, so `make verify` does execute them.

The match is case-INSENSITIVE because `composer_edit.py:189` reads "DEPRECATED alias" in caps; a case-sensitive grep passes while that line is still stale.
- [x] `grep -c '\[operator-attested\]' docs/plan-review-gate.md` = 0 (4 occurrences today: `:112`, `:121`, `:1160`, `:1185` — all four are rewritten here, none is a fixture) and `grep -c '\[non-codebase\]' docs/plan-review-gate.md` = 5 (4 rewrites + the existing `:317`).
- [x] `grep -n '`init.py`\|`compact.py`\|`_processors.py`' docs/migrations.md` is empty (5 matching lines today: `:119`, `:276`, `:280`, `:284`, `:313`); `git diff -U0 -- src | grep '^[-+]' | grep -v '^[-+][-+]' | grep -v '^[-+]\s*#'` is empty, proving the `src` change is comment-only.
